name: Usain Bolt
description_en: Jamaican sprinter widely regarded as the greatest of all time. He set the 100 m world record of 9.58 s in 2009 — a mark that still stands. His triple-triple (100 m, 200 m, 4×100 m relay gold at three consecutive Olympics) has never been matched.
description_nl: Jamaicaanse sprinter die algemeen wordt beschouwd als de beste ooit. Hij vestigde het wereldrecord op de 100 m van 9,58 seconden in 2009 — een record dat nog steeds staat. Zijn triple-triple (100 m, 200 m en 4×100 m estafette goud op drie opeenvolgende Olympische Spelen) is nooit geëvenaard.

name: Michael Phelps
description_en: American swimmer and the most decorated Olympian in history, with 28 Olympic medals (23 gold). Competing across five Games from Sydney 2000 to Rio 2016, he won eight golds in a single Games (Beijing 2008), a record in itself.
description_nl: Amerikaans zwemmer en de meest gedecoreerde Olympiër in de geschiedenis, met 28 Olympische medailles (23 goud). Actief op vijf Spelen van Sydney 2000 tot Rio 2016, won hij acht gouden medailles op één Spelen (Peking 2008), op zichzelf al een record.
achievement: 23 Olympic gold medals — the most decorated Olympian of all time

name: Simone Biles
description_en: American artistic gymnast and the most decorated gymnast in World Championship history. She won four gold medals at Rio 2016 and added three more at Paris 2024 aged 27, cementing her status as the greatest gymnast of all time.
description_nl: Amerikaans artistiek turnster en de meest gedecoreerde gymnast in de geschiedenis van de Wereldkampioenschappen. Ze won vier gouden medailles op Rio 2016 en voegde er op 27-jarige leeftijd nog drie toe op Parijs 2024, waarmee ze haar status als de grootste gymnaste aller tijden bevestigde.

name: Carl Lewis
description_en: American sprinter and long jumper who dominated track and field for over a decade. He matched Jesse Owens's legendary four-gold haul at a single Games (Los Angeles 1984) and defended his long jump title at four consecutive Olympics.
description_nl: Amerikaans sprinter en verspringer die de atletiek meer dan een decennium domineerde. Hij evenaarde Jesse Owens' legendarische vier gouden medailles op één Spelen (Los Angeles 1984) en verdedigde zijn verspringtitel op vier opeenvolgende Olympische Spelen.

name: Nadia Comaneci
description_en: Romanian gymnast who, at just 14 years old, became the first athlete in Olympic history to be awarded a perfect score of 10.0 at the 1976 Montreal Games. The scoreboard wasn't even designed to display a 10 — it showed 1.00 instead.
description_nl: Roemeense turnster die op slechts 14-jarige leeftijd de eerste atleet in de olympische geschiedenis werd die een perfecte score van 10,0 ontving op de Spelen van Montreal 1976. Het scorebord was niet eens ontworpen om een 10 te tonen — het gaf 1,00 weer.
achievement: 5 Olympic gold medals · First gymnast to score a perfect 10 (1976)

name: Mark Spitz
description_en: American swimmer who won seven gold medals at the Munich 1972 Olympics — each in world record time — a feat that stood as the record for most golds in a single Games for 36 years until Michael Phelps won eight in Beijing.
description_nl: Amerikaans zwemmer die zeven gouden medailles won op de Olympische Spelen van München 1972 — elk in wereldrecordtijd — een prestatie die 36 jaar lang het record bleef voor de meeste gouden medailles op één Spelen, totdat Michael Phelps er acht won in Peking.
achievement: 9 Olympic gold medals · 7 golds in a single Games (Munich 1972)

name: Father of quantum theory · Energy quantization, 1900
description_en: At the very start of the 20th century, he solved the blackbody radiation problem by proposing that energy is emitted in discrete packets — quanta — laying the foundation of quantum theory.
description_nl: Aan het begin van de 20e eeuw loste hij het probleem van zwartlichaamsstraling op door voor te stellen dat energie in discrete pakketjes — quanta — wordt uitgestraald, wat de basis vormde van de kwantumtheorie.
milestone_en: Introduction of energy quantization (birth of quantum theory)
milestone_nl: Introductie van energie-kwantisatie (begin van de kwantumtheorie)
infograph_data: ["/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/planck/planck-2.webp","/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/planck/planck-3.webp","/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/planck/planck.webp"]
question_text_en: Which of these physicists launched quantum theory in 1900 by proposing that energy is emitted in discrete packets, or quanta?
question_text_nl: Welke van deze natuurkundigen legde in 1900 de basis voor de kwantumtheorie door voor te stellen dat energie in afzonderlijke pakketjes, of quanta, wordt uitgezonden?

name: Light quanta · Photoelectric effect, 1905
description_en: In the early years of quantum theory, he explained the photoelectric effect by proposing that light consists of particles (photons), providing strong evidence for the quantum idea.
description_nl: In de vroege jaren van de kwantumtheorie verklaarde hij het foto-elektrisch effect door voor te stellen dat licht uit deeltjes (fotonen) bestaat, wat sterk bewijs leverde voor het kwantumidee.
milestone_en: Discovery of light quanta (photons) and explanation of the photoelectric effect
milestone_nl: Ontdekking van lichtquanta (fotonen) en verklaring van het foto-elektrisch effect
infograph_data: ["/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/einstein/einstein-2.webp","/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/einstein/einstein-3.webp","/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/einstein/einstein.webp"]
question_text_en: Which of these physicists explained the photoelectric effect in 1905 by proposing that light itself consists of quanta, later called photons?
question_text_nl: Welke van deze natuurkundigen verklaarde in 1905 het foto-elektrisch effect door voor te stellen dat licht zelf uit quanta bestaat, later fotonen genoemd?

name: Quantized model of the atom, 1913
description_en: In the 1910s, he proposed that electrons orbit the nucleus in fixed quantised energy levels, explaining atomic spectra and advancing atomic theory.
description_nl: In de jaren 1910 stelde hij voor dat elektronen de kern omcirkelen in vaste gekwantiseerde energieniveaus, waarmee hij atomaire spectra verklaarde en de atoomtheorie vooruitbracht.
milestone_en: Quantized atomic model (Bohr model of the atom)
milestone_nl: Gekwantiseerd atoommodel (Bohr-model van het atoom)
infograph_data: ["/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/Bohr/Bohr-2.webp","/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/Bohr/Bohr-3.webp","/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/Bohr/Bohr-4.webp"]
question_text_en: Which of these physicists proposed in 1913 an atomic model in which electrons orbit the nucleus only in fixed, quantized energy levels?
question_text_nl: Welke van deze natuurkundigen stelde in 1913 een atoommodel voor waarin elektronen alleen in vaste, gekwantiseerde energieniveaus rond de kern draaien?

name: Matter waves · Wave–particle duality, 1924
description_en: In the 1920s, he proposed that all matter has wave-like properties, extending wave–particle duality beyond light to particles such as electrons.
description_nl: In de jaren 1920 stelde hij voor dat alle materie golfeigenschappen heeft, waarmee hij de golf-deeltjesdualiteit uitbreidde van licht naar deeltjes zoals elektronen.
milestone_en: Matter-wave hypothesis (wave–particle duality of matter)
milestone_nl: Materiegolf-hypothese (golf-deeltjesdualiteit van materie)
infograph_data: ["/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/broglie/broglie-2.webp","/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/broglie/broglie-3.webp","/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/broglie/broglie.webp"]
question_text_en: Which of these physicists suggested in 1924 that particles such as electrons also behave like waves?
question_text_nl: Welke van deze natuurkundigen opperde in 1924 dat deeltjes zoals elektronen zich ook als golven gedragen?

name: Matrix mechanics · Uncertainty principle, 1925–1927
description_en: In the mid-1920s, he formulated matrix mechanics — the first complete version of quantum mechanics — and later introduced the uncertainty principle, limiting how precisely certain properties can be known.
description_nl: In het midden van de jaren 1920 formuleerde hij matrixmechanica — de eerste volledige versie van de kwantummechanica — en introduceerde later het onzekerheidsbeginsel, dat grenzen stelt aan hoe precies bepaalde eigenschappen gekend kunnen worden.
milestone_en: Matrix mechanics and the uncertainty principle
milestone_nl: Matrixmechanica en het onzekerheidsbeginsel
infograph_data: ["/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/heisenberg/heisenberg-3.webp","/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/heisenberg/heisenberg-4.webp","/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/heisenberg/heisenberg.webp"]
question_text_en: Which of these physicists developed matrix mechanics and formulated the uncertainty principle, which limits how precisely position and momentum can be known at the same time?
question_text_nl: Welke van deze natuurkundigen ontwikkelde de matrixmechanica en formuleerde het onzekerheidsprincipe, dat beperkt hoe nauwkeurig plaats en impuls tegelijk bekend kunnen zijn?

name: Wave mechanics · Wave equation, 1926
description_en: Shortly afterward in the 1920s, he developed wave mechanics and the Schrödinger equation, describing how quantum states evolve over time.
description_nl: Kort daarna in de jaren 1920 ontwikkelde hij golfmechanica en de Schrödingervergelijking, die beschrijft hoe kwantumtoestanden in de tijd evolueren.
milestone_en: Wave mechanics and the Schrödinger equation
milestone_nl: Golfmechanica en de Schrödingervergelijking
infograph_data: ["/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/schrodinger/schrodinger-2.webp","/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/schrodinger/schrodinger-3.webp","/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/schrodinger/schrodinger-4.webp"]
question_text_en: Which of these physicists formulated wave mechanics in 1926, including the famous equation that describes how a quantum system evolves over time?
question_text_nl: Welke van deze natuurkundigen formuleerde in 1926 de golfmechanica, inclusief de beroemde vergelijking die beschrijft hoe een kwantumsysteem zich in de tijd ontwikkelt?

name: Probabilistic interpretation of the wave function, 1926
description_en: Later in the 1920s, he provided the probabilistic interpretation of the wave function, showing that it predicts the likelihood of finding a particle at a given position.
description_nl: Later in de jaren 1920 gaf hij de probabilistische interpretatie van de golffunctie, die de kans voorspelt om een deeltje op een bepaalde plaats te vinden.
milestone_en: Probabilistic interpretation of the wave function
milestone_nl: Probabilistische interpretatie van de golffunctie
infograph_data: ["/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/born/born-2.webp","/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/born/born-3.webp","/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/born/born-5.webp"]
question_text_en: Which of these physicists showed in 1926 that the wave function gives the probability of finding a particle at a particular place?
question_text_nl: Welke van deze natuurkundigen toonde in 1926 aan dat de golffunctie de kans aangeeft om een deeltje op een bepaalde plaats aan te treffen?

name: Relativistic quantum mechanics · Prediction of antimatter, 1928
description_en: Towards the end of the 1920s, he unified quantum mechanics and special relativity in a single equation, which predicted the existence of new particles such as antimatter.
description_nl: Tegen het einde van de jaren 1920 verenigde hij kwantummechanica en speciale relativiteit in één vergelijking, die het bestaan van nieuwe deeltjes zoals antimaterie voorspelde.
milestone_en: Relativistic quantum mechanics and prediction of antimatter
milestone_nl: Relativistische kwantummechanica en voorspelling van antimaterie
infograph_data: ["/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/dirac/dirac-2.webp","/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/dirac/dirac-3.webp","/api/images/challenges/science/quantum/dirac/dirac-4.webp"]
question_text_en: Which of these physicists combined quantum mechanics with special relativity in 1928, leading him to predict the existence of antimatter?
question_text_nl: Welke van deze natuurkundigen combineerde in 1928 de kwantummechanica met de speciale relativiteitstheorie en voorspelde daardoor het bestaan van antimaterie?

name: Julius Caesar
description_en: Roman general and statesman who ended the Republic by seizing power. Assassinated on the Ides of March, 44 BC.
description_nl: Romeins veldheer en staatsman die de Republiek ten einde bracht. Vermoord op de Iden van Maart, 44 v.Chr.
milestone_en: End of the Roman Republic and rise of one-man rule
milestone_nl: Einde van de Romeinse Republiek en opkomst van alleenheerschappij

name: Augustus
description_en: Caesar's adopted heir who won the civil wars and became Rome's first true emperor. His reign brought the Pax Romana.
description_nl: Caesars geadopteerde erfgenaam die de burgeroorlogen won en Rome's eerste echte keizer werd. Zijn bewind bracht de Pax Romana.
milestone_en: Foundation of the Roman Empire and beginning of the Pax Romana
milestone_nl: Stichting van het Romeinse Keizerrijk en begin van de Pax Romana

name: Tiberius
description_en: A capable general who became a reclusive ruler, retreating to Capri and leaving Rome governed by the feared Sejanus.
description_nl: Een bekwaam veldheer die een teruggetrokken heerser werd. Hij trok zich terug op Capri en liet Rome besturen door de gevreesde Sejanus.
milestone_en: First imperial succession consolidating Augustus’ system
milestone_nl: Eerste keizerlijke opvolging die het systeem van Augustus consolideerde

name: Caligula
description_en: Initially popular, he descended into cruelty and erratic behaviour. Assassinated by his own Praetorian Guard after four years.
description_nl: Aanvankelijk populair, verviel hij in wreedheid en grillig gedrag. Na vier jaar vermoord door zijn eigen Praetoriaanse Garde.
milestone_en: Crisis of imperial rule highlighting dangers of absolute power
milestone_nl: Crisis van het keizerschap die de gevaren van absolute macht toonde

name: Claudius
description_en: Considered a fool by his family, he proved a capable administrator. He conquered Britain and expanded Roman citizenship.
description_nl: Door zijn familie als een dwaas beschouwd, bleek hij een bekwaam bestuurder. Hij veroverde Britannia en breidde het Romeins burgerschap uit.
milestone_en: Expansion of the empire, including the conquest of Britain
milestone_nl: Uitbreiding van het rijk, inclusief de verovering van Britannia

name: Nero
description_en: Last of the Julio-Claudians. Notorious for persecuting Christians and his artistic pretensions. Fled Rome and died by suicide.
description_nl: De laatste Julio-Claudiër. Berucht om zijn vervolging van christenen en zijn artistieke pretenties. Vluchtte uit Rome en stierf door zelfdoding.
milestone_en: End of the Julio-Claudian dynasty and destabilization of the empire
milestone_nl: Einde van de Julio-Claudische dynastie en destabilisatie van het rijk

name: Galba
description_en: The first emperor not from Rome or Italy. His strict frugality alienated the army and he was murdered after just seven months.
description_nl: De eerste keizer die niet uit Rome of Italië stamde. Zijn strenge zuinigheid vervreemdde het leger en hij werd na zeven maanden vermoord.
milestone_en: Beginning of the Year of the Four Emperors
milestone_nl: Begin van het Jaar van de Vier Keizers

name: Otho
description_en: Former friend of Nero who seized power from Galba. He ruled for only 95 days before taking his own life after a military defeat.
description_nl: Voormalig vriend van Nero die de macht van Galba overnam. Hij regeerde slechts 95 dagen en pleegde zelfmoord na een militaire nederlaag.
milestone_en: Continuation of rapid power struggles during imperial crisis
milestone_nl: Voortzetting van snelle machtswisselingen tijdens de keizerlijke crisis

name: Vitellius
description_en: Known for lavish banquets and gluttony. His brief reign ended when Vespasian's forces defeated him and he was killed by a mob.
description_nl: Bekend om weelderige banketten en vraatzucht. Zijn korte bewind eindigde toen Vespasianus' troepen hem versloegen en hij door een menigte werd gedood.
milestone_en: Climax of the Year of the Four Emperors chaos
milestone_nl: Hoogtepunt van de chaos tijdens het Jaar van de Vier Keizers

name: Vespasian
description_en: A general of humble origin who restored stability after the Year of the Four Emperors and founded the Flavian dynasty.
description_nl: Een generaal van bescheiden afkomst die stabiliteit herstelde na het Jaar van de Vier Keizers en de Flavische dynastie stichtte.
milestone_en: Restoration of stability and founding of the Flavian dynasty
milestone_nl: Herstel van stabiliteit en stichting van de Flavische dynastie

name: Titus
description_en: Beloved for his generosity, he oversaw the destruction of Jerusalem and responded admirably to the eruption of Vesuvius.
description_nl: Geliefd om zijn vrijgevigheid. Hij leidde de verwoesting van Jeruzalem en reageerde bewonderenswaardig op de uitbarsting van de Vesuvius.
milestone_en: Peak of Flavian rule marked by major events and public works
milestone_nl: Hoogtepunt van de Flavische heerschappij gekenmerkt door grote gebeurtenissen en publieke werken

name: Domitian
description_en: An efficient but autocratic ruler who demanded to be called 'Lord and God'. His assassination ended the Flavian dynasty.
description_nl: Een efficiënte maar autocratische heerser die eiste 'Heer en God' genoemd te worden. Zijn moord beëindigde de Flavische dynastie.
milestone_en: End of the Flavian dynasty and transition to a new imperial era
milestone_nl: Einde van de Flavische dynastie en overgang naar een nieuwe keizerlijke periode

name: The Mona Lisa
description_en: Painted by Leonardo da Vinci, the Mona Lisa is a portrait of Lisa Gherardini, and it is famous for its subject's enigmatic expression.
description_nl: Geschilderd door Leonardo da Vinci, is de Mona Lisa een portret van Lisa Gherardini en beroemd vanwege de mysterieuze uitdrukking van het onderwerp.

question_text_en: Which Italian Renaissance master painted this portrait of a woman with an enigmatic smile, now displayed at the Louvre in Paris?

name: The Birth of Venus
description_en: Created by Sandro Botticelli, this painting shows Venus emerging from the sea as a fully grown woman, standing on a shell.
description_nl: Gemaakt door Sandro Botticelli, toont dit schilderij Venus die als volwassen vrouw vanuit de zee op een schelp verschijnt.

question_text_en: Which Italian painter created this depiction of the goddess Venus emerging from the sea on a shell, one of the defining images of the early Renaissance?

name: The School of Athens
description_en: Raphael's The School of Athens illustrates the greatest philosophers of classical antiquity gathered together under one roof.
description_nl: Rafaëls De School van Athene toont de grootste filosofen van de klassieke oudheid verzameld onder één dak.
infograph_data: ["/api/images/challenges/art/renaissance/school-of-athens/school-of-athens-1.webp","/api/images/challenges/art/renaissance/school-of-athens/school-of-athens-2.webp","/api/images/challenges/art/renaissance/school-of-athens/school-of-athens-3.webp"]
question_text_en: Which Italian painter filled this fresco with history's great philosophers gathered beneath grand classical arches, commissioned for the Vatican's Apostolic Palace?

name: The Creation of Adam
description_en: Found within the Sistine Chapel ceiling, Michelangelo's work depicts God giving life to Adam, the first man.
description_nl: Te vinden op het plafond van de Sixtijnse Kapel, toont Michelangelo's werk God die Adam, de eerste mens, leven geeft.

question_text_en: Which Italian artist painted this famous scene of God reaching out to give life to Adam, as part of the Sistine Chapel ceiling?

name: The Arnolfini Portrait
description_en: This work by Jan van Eyck is famous for its detailed depiction of a wealthy couple and its intricate use of light and reflection.
description_nl: Dit werk van Jan van Eyck is beroemd om de gedetailleerde weergave van een rijk koppel en het complexe gebruik van licht en reflectie.

question_text_en: Which Early Netherlandish painter created this richly detailed double portrait, famous for the convex mirror reflecting the room behind the couple?

name: David
description_en: A bronze sculpture by Donatello, representing David after his victory over Goliath, notable for being the first free-standing nude statue since antiquity.
description_nl: Een bronzen beeld van Donatello dat David na zijn overwinning op Goliath voorstelt, bekend als het eerste vrijstaande naakte beeld sinds de oudheid.

question_text_en: Which Italian sculptor created this bronze statue of the biblical hero, the first freestanding nude male statue since antiquity?

name: Venus of Urbino
description_en: Painted by Titian, this artwork portrays a reclining nude woman symbolizing beauty and sensuality.
description_nl: Geschilderd door Titiaan, toont dit werk een liggende naakte vrouw als symbool van schoonheid en sensualiteit.

question_text_en: Which Italian painter created this reclining nude, one of the most celebrated depictions of the female form in Renaissance art?

name: The Garden of Earthly Delights
description_en: A triptych by Hieronymus Bosch depicting paradise, earthly pleasures, and hell.
description_nl: Een drieluik van Jheronimus Bosch dat het paradijs, aardse genoegens en de hel toont.

question_text_en: Which Early Netherlandish painter created this fantastical triptych, packed with surreal imagery of paradise, earthly pleasure, and hell?

name: The Ambassadors
description_en: Painted by Hans Holbein the Younger, this artwork is known for its hidden skull anamorphosis.
description_nl: Geschilderd door Hans Holbein de Jongere, bekend om de verborgen schedel in anamorfose.
infograph_data: ["/api/images/challenges/art/renaissance/the-ambassadors/the-ambassadors-1.webp","/api/images/challenges/art/renaissance/the-ambassadors/the-ambassadors-2.webp","/api/images/challenges/art/renaissance/the-ambassadors/the-ambassadors-3.webp"]
question_text_en: Which German-born painter created this double portrait, famous for the distorted skull hidden in the foreground when viewed at an angle?

name: The Physical Impossibility of Death in the Mind of Someone Living
description_en: Created in 1991, this work by Damien Hirst features a shark suspended in formaldehyde and is one of the iconic pieces of the YBA movement.
description_nl: Gemaakt in 1991, toont dit werk van Damien Hirst een haai in formaldehyde en is een van de iconische stukken van de YBA-beweging.

question_text_en: Which British artist created the 1991 artwork featuring a shark suspended in formaldehyde, one of the most iconic works of the Young British Artists movement?

name: Balloon Dog
description_en: Jeff Koons’ Balloon Dog is a series of large-scale sculptures made from high-chromium stainless steel and brings a playful commentary on consumerism.
description_nl: Jeff Koons' Balloon Dog is een reeks grootschalige sculpturen van hoogglans chroom roestvrij staal en biedt een speelse kijk op consumentisme.

question_text_en: Which American artist created the famous Balloon Dog sculptures, known for their shiny stainless-steel surfaces and playful take on consumer culture?

name: Obliteration Room
description_en: Kusama’s interactive installation allows visitors to cover a white room with colorful dot stickers, creating a dynamic and evolving piece.
description_nl: Kusama's interactieve installatie laat bezoekers een witte kamer bedekken met kleurrijke stippenstickers, waardoor een dynamisch en veranderlijk kunstwerk ontstaat.
infograph_data: ["/api/images/challenges/art/contemporary/obliteration_room/obliteration_room-1.webp","/api/images/challenges/art/contemporary/obliteration_room/obliteration_room-2.webp","/api/images/challenges/art/contemporary/obliteration_room/obliteration_room-3.webp"]
question_text_en: Which Japanese artist created the interactive installation The Obliteration Room, where visitors cover a white room with colorful dot stickers?

description_en: Takashi Murakami’s 727 features his iconic Mr. DOB character in a vibrant, anime-inspired composition blending fine art and commercial aesthetics.
description_nl: Takashi Murakami's 727 toont zijn iconische Mr. DOB-personage in een levendige, door anime geïnspireerde compositie die kunst en commercie combineert.

question_text_en: Which Japanese artist created 727, featuring the iconic Mr. DOB character in a colorful, anime-inspired style?

name: Untitled (Cowboy)

milestone_en: Crossed the Alps with elephants to invade Italy.
milestone_nl: Stak de Alpen over met olifanten om Italië binnen te vallen.

His victories, especially at Cannae, made him one of the most feared commanders in Roman history."}

name: Scipio Africanus
description_en: Scipio Africanus was the Roman general who defeated Hannibal at the Battle of Zama, securing Roman dominance.
description_nl: Scipio Africanus was de Romeinse generaal die Hannibal versloeg in de Slag bij Zama en zo de Romeinse dominantie veiligstelde.
milestone_en: Defeated Hannibal at Zama.
milestone_nl: Versloeg Hannibal bij Zama.
infograph_data: {"countryIso2":"IT","country":"Roman Republic, Italy","fields":[{"label":"period","value":"Second Punic War, 218–201 BC"},{"label":"role","value":"Roman general and statesman"},{"label":"keyAction","value":"Defeated Hannibal at the Battle of Zama"},{"label":"legacy","value":"Secured Rome’s victory over Carthage and expanded Roman power"}],"images":["/api/images/challenges/history/rome_republic/scipio-africanus/scipio-africanus-1.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_republic/scipio-africanus/scipio-africanus-2.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_republic/scipio-africanus/scipio-africanus-3.webp"],"description":"Scipio Africanus rose to fame during the Second Punic War. By defeating Hannibal at Zama, he ended Carthage’s greatest threat to Rome and helped establish Roman dominance in the western Mediterranean."}

name: Gracchus brothers
description_en: Tiberius and Gaius Gracchus attempted land reforms to redistribute wealth, triggering political violence.
description_nl: Tiberius and Gaius Gracchus s probeerde landhervormingen door te voeren om rijkdom te herverdelen, wat leidde tot politiek geweld.
milestone_en: Introduced land reforms and was killed.
milestone_nl: Voerde landhervormingen in en werd gedood.
infograph_data: {"countryIso2":"IT","country":"Roman Republic, Italy","fields":[{"label":"period","value":"Late 2nd century BC"},{"label":"role","value":"Roman reformers and tribunes"},{"label":"keyAction","value":"Promoted land redistribution and social reforms"},{"label":"legacy","value":"Their deaths exposed deep social and political conflict in the Republic"}],"images":["/api/images/challenges/history/rome_republic/graccius-brothers/graccius-brothers-1.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_republic/graccius-brothers/graccius-brothers-2.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_republic/graccius-brothers/graccius-brothers-3.webp"],"description":"Tiberius and Gaius Gracchus tried to address inequality in the Roman Republic through land and political reforms. Their violent deaths marked an important step toward the instability that later weakened the Republic."}

name: Gaius Marius
description_en: Marius reformed the Roman army, allowing the poor to enlist and creating a professional military force.
description_nl: Marius hervormde het Romeinse leger en liet ook armen toetreden, waardoor een professioneel leger ontstond.
milestone_en: Reformed the Roman army.
milestone_nl: Hervormde het Romeinse leger.
infograph_data: {"countryIso2":"IT","country":"Roman Republic, Italy","fields":[{"label":"period","value":"Late 2nd–early 1st century BC"},{"label":"role","value":"Roman general, consul, and military reformer"},{"label":"keyAction","value":"Opened military service to poorer citizens"},{"label":"legacy","value":"Helped create a professional army loyal to commanders as well as Rome"}],"images":["/api/images/challenges/history/rome_republic/gaius-marius/gaius-marius-1.webp"],"description":"Gaius Marius changed the Roman army by recruiting poorer citizens and reshaping military service. His reforms strengthened Rome’s armies but also contributed to the rise of generals with personal political power."}

name: Lucius Cornelius Sulla
description_en: Sulla marched on Rome and became dictator, setting a precedent for military intervention in politics.
description_nl: Sulla marcheerde op Rome en werd dictator, wat een precedent schiep voor militaire inmenging in de politiek.
milestone_en: Seized Rome and ruled as dictator.
milestone_nl: Nam Rome in en regeerde als dictator.
infograph_data: {"countryIso2":"IT","country":"Roman Republic, Italy","fields":[{"label":"period","value":"Early 1st century BC"},{"label":"role","value":"Roman general and dictator"},{"label":"keyAction","value":"Marched on Rome and seized dictatorial power"},{"label":"legacy","value":"Set a dangerous precedent for military force in Roman politics"}],"images":["/api/images/challenges/history/rome_republic/lucius-cornelius-sulla/lucius-cornelius-sulla-1.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_republic/lucius-cornelius-sulla/lucius-cornelius-sulla-2.webp"],"description":"Lucius Cornelius Sulla became one of the first Roman generals to use his army to take control of Rome itself. His dictatorship and constitutional reforms revealed how fragile the Republic had become."}

name: Spartacus
description_en: Spartacus was a gladiator who led a massive slave revolt against Rome, challenging its authority.
description_nl: Spartacus was een gladiator die een grote slavenopstand leidde tegen Rome en zijn gezag uitdaagde.
milestone_en: Led the largest slave revolt in Roman history.
milestone_nl: Leidde de grootste slavenopstand in de Romeinse geschiedenis.
infograph_data: {"countryIso2":"BG","country":"Thrace / Roman Republic","fields":[{"label":"period","value":"Third Servile War, 73–71 BC"},{"label":"role","value":"Gladiator and rebel leader"},{"label":"keyAction","value":"Led a major slave uprising against Rome"},{"label":"legacy","value":"Became a lasting symbol of resistance against oppression"}],"images":["/api/images/challenges/history/rome_republic/spartacus/spartacus-1.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_republic/spartacus/spartacus-2.webp"],"description":"Spartacus led one of the most famous slave revolts in ancient history. His rebellion challenged Roman authority and forced the Republic to respond with massive military force."}

name: Gnaeus Pompeius Magnus (Pompey)
description_en: Pompey was a powerful general who expanded Roman territory and later became a rival of Caesar.
description_nl: Pompeius was een machtige generaal die Romeinse gebieden uitbreidde en later een rivaal van Caesar werd.
milestone_en: Expanded Roman power and fought Caesar.
milestone_nl: Breidde de macht van Rome uit en vocht tegen Caesar.
infograph_data: {"countryIso2":"IT","country":"Roman Republic, Italy","fields":[{"label":"period","value":"1st century BC"},{"label":"role","value":"Roman general and political leader"},{"label":"keyAction","value":"Expanded Roman influence in the eastern Mediterranean"},{"label":"legacy","value":"His rivalry with Caesar helped trigger civil war"}],"images":["/api/images/challenges/history/rome_republic/gnaeus-pompeius-magnus/gnaeus-pompeius-magnus-1.webp"],"description":"Pompey was one of Rome’s most successful generals and a key member of the First Triumvirate. His later conflict with Julius Caesar pushed the Republic into civil war."}

name: Marcus Licinius Crassus
description_en: Crassus was the wealthiest man in Rome and part of the First Triumvirate, helping Caesar rise to power.
description_nl: Crassus was de rijkste man van Rome en maakte deel uit van het Eerste Triumviraat, wat Caesar hielp aan de macht te komen.
milestone_en: Formed the First Triumvirate.
milestone_nl: Vormde het Eerste Triumviraat.
infograph_data: {"countryIso2":"IT","country":"Roman Republic, Italy","fields":[{"label":"period","value":"1st century BC"},{"label":"role","value":"Roman politician, general, and financier"},{"label":"keyAction","value":"Joined Caesar and Pompey in the First Triumvirate"},{"label":"legacy","value":"Used immense wealth to shape Roman politics"}],"images":["/api/images/challenges/history/rome_republic/marcus-licinius-crassus/marcus-licinius-crassus-1.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_republic/marcus-licinius-crassus/marcus-licinius-crassus-2.webp"],"description":"Marcus Licinius Crassus was famous for his enormous wealth and political influence. As part of the First Triumvirate, he helped reshape Roman politics alongside Julius Caesar and Pompey."}

name: Julius Caesar
description_en: Julius Caesar was a general whose actions led to the end of the Roman Republic and his eventual assassination.
description_nl: Julius Caesar was een generaal wiens daden leidden tot het einde van de Romeinse Republiek en zijn uiteindelijke moord.
milestone_en: Crossed the Rubicon and became dictator.
milestone_nl: Stak de Rubicon over en werd dictator.
infograph_data: {"countryIso2":"IT","country":"Roman Republic, Italy","fields":[{"label":"period","value":"Late Roman Republic"},{"label":"role","value":"Roman general, statesman, and dictator"},{"label":"keyAction","value":"Crossed the Rubicon and took control of Rome"},{"label":"legacy","value":"His rise and assassination accelerated the end of the Republic"}],"images":["/api/images/challenges/history/rome_republic/julius-caesar/julius-caesar-1.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_republic/julius-caesar/julius-caesar-2.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_republic/julius-caesar/julius-caesar-3.webp"],"description":"Julius Caesar’s military success and political ambition transformed Rome. His crossing of the Rubicon began a civil war, and his dictatorship helped bring the Roman Republic to an end."}

name: Augustus
description_en: Augustus was the first Roman emperor and founder of the Roman Empire, bringing stability after years of civil war.
description_nl: Augustus was de eerste Romeinse keizer en stichter van het Romeinse Rijk, die stabiliteit bracht na jaren van burgeroorlog.
milestone_en: Founded the Roman Empire and established the Pax Romana.
milestone_nl: Stichtte het Romeinse Rijk en vestigde de Pax Romana.
infograph_data: {"countryIso2":"IT","country":"Rome, Italy","fields":[{"label":"period","value":"Late 1st century BC–early 1st century AD"},{"label":"role","value":"First Roman emperor and founder of the Empire"},{"label":"keyAction","value":"Ended civil war and established the Principate"},{"label":"legacy","value":"Created the Pax Romana and shaped imperial rule for centuries"}],"images":["/api/images/challenges/history/rome_empire/augustus/augustus-1.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_empire/augustus/augustus-2.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_empire/augustus/augustus-3.webp"],"description":"Augustus transformed Rome from a republic torn by civil war into a stable imperial system. As the first emperor, he founded the Principate, promoted peace and prosperity, and began the long era remembered as the Pax Romana."}

name: Tiberius
description_en: Tiberius succeeded Augustus and ruled as a capable but increasingly reclusive emperor.
description_nl: Tiberius volgde Augustus op en regeerde als een capabele maar steeds teruggetrokken keizer.
milestone_en: Second emperor of Rome.
milestone_nl: Tweede keizer van Rome.
infograph_data: {"countryIso2":"IT","country":"Roman Empire, Italy","fields":[{"label":"period","value":"Early 1st century AD"},{"label":"role","value":"Second Roman emperor"},{"label":"keyAction","value":"Maintained the imperial system created by Augustus"},{"label":"legacy","value":"Remembered as a capable but increasingly withdrawn ruler"}],"images":["/api/images/challenges/history/rome_empire/tiberius/tiberius-1.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_empire/tiberius/tiberius-2.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_empire/tiberius/tiberius-3.webp"],"description":"Tiberius inherited the empire from Augustus and helped prove that one-man rule could continue beyond its founder. His reign was administratively strong, but his later withdrawal from Rome damaged his reputation."}

name: Caligula
description_en: Caligula is remembered for his erratic behavior and tyranny during his short reign.
description_nl: Caligula staat bekend om zijn grillige gedrag en tirannie tijdens zijn korte regeerperiode.
milestone_en: Notorious for cruelty and extravagance.
milestone_nl: Berucht om wreedheid en extravagantie.

His assassination revealed the dangers of unchecked imperial power and the fragility of the early empire."}

name: Claudius
description_en: Claudius expanded the empire, notably conquering Britain, and improved Roman administration.
description_nl: Claudius breidde het rijk uit, onder meer door Britannia te veroveren, en verbeterde het bestuur.
milestone_en: Conquered Britain.
milestone_nl: Veroverde Britannia.
infograph_data: {"countryIso2":"IT","country":"Roman Empire, Italy","fields":[{"label":"period","value":"AD 41–54"},{"label":"role","value":"Roman emperor and administrator"},{"label":"keyAction","value":"Conquered Britain and expanded imperial administration"},{"label":"legacy","value":"Strengthened the empire despite being underestimated by elites"}],"images":["/api/images/challenges/history/rome_empire/claudius/claudius-1.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_empire/claudius/claudius-2.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_empire/claudius/claudius-3.webp"],"description":"Claudius expanded Roman power by conquering Britain and improving the machinery of government. Though often underestimated, he proved to be an effective ruler and strengthened imperial administration."}

name: Nero
description_en: Nero is infamous for his persecution of Christians and the Great Fire of Rome.
description_nl: Nero is berucht om zijn vervolging van christenen en de Grote Brand van Rome.
milestone_en: Associated with the Great Fire of Rome.
milestone_nl: Geassocieerd met de Grote Brand van Rome.
infograph_data: {"countryIso2":"IT","country":"Rome, Italy","fields":[{"label":"period","value":"AD 54–68"},{"label":"role","value":"Roman emperor of the Julio-Claudian dynasty"},{"label":"keyAction","value":"Ruled during the Great Fire of Rome and persecuted Christians"},{"label":"legacy","value":"His fall ended the Julio-Claudian dynasty and triggered civil war"}],"images":["/api/images/challenges/history/rome_empire/nero/nero-1.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_empire/nero/nero-2.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_empire/nero/nero-3.webp"],"description":"Nero is one of Rome’s most notorious emperors, associated with artistic excess, repression, and the Great Fire of Rome. His death ended the Julio-Claudian line and led to the chaotic Year of the Four Emperors."}

name: Vespasian
description_en: Vespasian restored stability after civil war and began construction of the Colosseum.
description_nl: Vespasianus herstelde stabiliteit na burgeroorlog en begon met de bouw van het Colosseum.
milestone_en: Founded the Flavian dynasty and started the Colosseum.
milestone_nl: Stichtte de Flavische dynastie en begon het Colosseum.

His practical rule restored finances, strengthened the empire, and began the construction of the Colosseum."}

name: Trajan
description_en: Trajan expanded the empire to its greatest territorial extent and was known as an excellent ruler.
description_nl: Trajanus breidde het rijk uit tot zijn grootste omvang en stond bekend als een uitstekende heerser.
milestone_en: Expanded the empire to its maximum size.
milestone_nl: Breidde het rijk uit tot zijn maximale omvang.

Later generations remembered him as an ideal ruler and a model of imperial success."}

name: Hadrian
description_en: Hadrian consolidated the empire and built defensive structures like Hadrian’s Wall in Britain.
description_nl: Hadrianus consolideerde het rijk en bouwde verdedigingswerken zoals de Muur van Hadrianus in Britannia.
milestone_en: Built Hadrian’s Wall.
milestone_nl: Bouwde de Muur van Hadrianus.

His reign is closely associated with strong frontiers, especially Hadrian’s Wall in Britain, and with a more defensive imperial policy."}

name: Marcus Aurelius
description_en: Marcus Aurelius was a philosopher-emperor known for his Stoic writings and leadership during wars.
description_nl: Marcus Aurelius was een filosoof-keizer, bekend om zijn stoïcijnse geschriften en leiderschap tijdens oorlogen.
milestone_en: Wrote Meditations and ruled during crisis.
milestone_nl: Schreef Meditations en regeerde tijdens crisissen.

His Stoic reflections in Meditations made him famous as the philosopher-emperor."}

name: Diocletian
description_en: Diocletian reorganized the empire and established the Tetrarchy to improve governance.
description_nl: Diocletianus reorganiseerde het rijk en voerde de Tetrarchie in om het bestuur te verbeteren.
milestone_en: Divided the empire into eastern and western halves.
milestone_nl: Verdeelde het rijk in een oostelijk en westelijk deel.

By dividing authority through the Tetrarchy and restructuring government, he helped stabilize the Roman Empire while also preparing the way for its later eastern and western split."}

name: Constantine the Great
description_en: Constantine legalized Christianity and founded Constantinople as a new capital.
description_nl: Constantijn de Grote legaliseerde het christendom en stichtte Constantinopel als nieuwe hoofdstad.
milestone_en: Issued the Edict of Milan and founded Constantinople.
milestone_nl: Vaardigde het Edict van Milaan uit en stichtte Constantinopel.

His rule reshaped the empire’s religion, politics, and long-term center of power."}

name: Romulus Augustulus
description_en: Romulus Augustulus was the last Western Roman emperor, marking the end of the Western Roman Empire.
description_nl: Romulus Augustulus was de laatste West-Romeinse keizer en markeert het einde van het West-Romeinse Rijk.
milestone_en: Last emperor of the Western Roman Empire.
milestone_nl: Laatste keizer van het West-Romeinse Rijk.
infograph_data: {"countryIso2":"IT","country":"Western Roman Empire, Italy","fields":[{"label":"period","value":"AD 475–476"},{"label":"role","value":"Last Western Roman emperor"},{"label":"keyAction","value":"Was deposed by Odoacer in AD 476"},{"label":"legacy","value":"His fall traditionally marks the end of the Western Roman Empire"}],"images":["/api/images/challenges/history/rome_empire/romulus-augustulus/romulus-augustulus-1.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_empire/romulus-augustulus/romulus-augustulus-2.webp","/api/images/challenges/history/rome_empire/romulus-augustulus/romulus-augustulus-3.webp"],"description":"Romulus Augustulus is remembered as the last emperor of the Western Roman Empire. His deposition in AD 476 became the traditional marker for the end of ancient Rome’s western imperial rule."}

name: Christopher Columbus
description_en: Genoese navigator who sailed for Spain and reached the Americas in 1492, opening the era of European exploration and colonisation.
description_nl: Genuese zeevaarder die voor Spanje voer en in 1492 Amerika bereikte, waarmee hij het tijdperk van Europese verkenning en kolonisatie inluidde.
milestone_en: First transatlantic voyage linking Europe and the Americas
milestone_nl: Eerste trans-Atlantische reis die Europa en Amerika met elkaar verbond

His voyages began sustained European exploration, conquest, and colonisation of the Americas."}

name: Vasco Núñez de Balboa
description_en: First European to see the Pacific Ocean from the Americas after crossing the Isthmus of Darién in 1513, claiming the sea for Spain.
description_nl: De eerste Europeaan die de Stille Oceaan vanuit Amerika zag na het oversteken van de landengte van Darién in 1513, en de zee voor Spanje opeiste.
milestone_en: Discovery of the Pacific Ocean from the New World
milestone_nl: Ontdekking van de Stille Oceaan vanuit de Nieuwe Wereld

His expedition expanded Spanish ambitions across the New World."}

name: Hernán Cortés
description_en: Led the Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire between 1519 and 1521, toppling Tenochtitlán and claiming Mexico for the Spanish Crown.
description_nl: Leidde de Spaanse verovering van het Azteekse Rijk tussen 1519 en 1521, veroverde Tenochtitlán en claimde Mexico voor de Spaanse kroon.
milestone_en: Conquest of the Aztec Empire and expansion into Mesoamerica

name: Francisco Pizarro
description_en: Conquered the Inca Empire in the 1530s with a small force, capturing Emperor Atahualpa and claiming vast Andean territories for Spain.
description_nl: Veroverde het Incarijk in de jaren 1530 met een kleine troepenmacht, greep keizer Atahualpa en claimde uitgestrekte Andesgebieden voor Spanje.
milestone_en: Conquest of the Inca Empire and control of the Andes
milestone_nl: Verovering van het Incarijk en controle over de Andes

name: Diego de Almagro
description_en: Partner of Pizarro in the Peru conquest; later led a gruelling expedition to Chile in 1535–36, finding little gold and returning defeated.
description_nl: Partner van Pizarro bij de verovering van Peru; leidde later een uitputtende expeditie naar Chili in 1535–36, vond weinig goud en keerde verslagen terug.
milestone_en: Exploration of southern South America and early Chile expeditions
milestone_nl: Verkenning van zuidelijk Zuid-Amerika en vroege expedities naar Chili

name: Pedro de Valdivia
description_en: Conquered and settled Chile from 1540 onward, founding Santiago and other cities before being killed in battle with the Mapuche in 1553.
description_nl: Veroverde en koloniseerde Chili vanaf 1540, stichtte Santiago en andere steden voordat hij in 1553 in gevecht met de Mapuche sneuvelde.
milestone_en: Colonisation and urban foundation of Chile
milestone_nl: Kolonisatie en stichting van steden in Chili

name: Gonzalo Pizarro
description_en: Half-brother of Francisco Pizarro who led a disastrous expedition east of the Andes in 1541–42 searching for El Dorado and the Land of Cinnamon.
description_nl: Halfbroer van Francisco Pizarro die in 1541–42 een rampzalige expeditie ten oosten van de Andes leidde op zoek naar El Dorado en het Kaneelland.
milestone_en: Expeditions into the Amazon basin in search of El Dorado
milestone_nl: Expedities in het Amazonegebied op zoek naar El Dorado

name: Francisco de Orellana
description_en: Separated from Gonzalo Pizarro's expedition and in 1541–42 became the first European to navigate the entire length of the Amazon River.
description_nl: Scheidde zich af van Gonzalo Pizarro's expeditie en werd in 1541–42 de eerste Europeaan die de volledige Amazone-rivier bevuhr.
milestone_en: First navigation of the Amazon River from Andes to Atlantic
milestone_nl: Eerste volledige bevaring van de Amazone van de Andes tot de Atlantische Oceaan

name: Białowieża Forest
description_en: Białowieża Forest is one of the last and largest remaining parts of the immense primeval forest that once spread across the European Plain. It is home to diverse wildlife, including the European bison.
description_nl: Het Białowieża-woud is een van de laatste en grootste resterende delen van het immense oerbos dat ooit over de Europese Vlakte verspreid lag. Het herbergt diverse wilde dieren, waaronder de Europese bizon.

name: Doñana National Park
description_en: Doñana National Park is a unique and largely untouched coastal wetland and a notable biodiversity hotspot. It is famous for its migratory bird populations and endangered Iberian lynx.
description_nl: Het Doñana Nationaal Park is een uniek en grotendeels onaangetast kustmoeras en een opmerkelijk biodiversiteitshotspot. Het staat bekend om zijn trekvogelpopulaties en de bedreigde Iberische lynx.

name: Vatnajökull National Park
description_en: Vatnajökull National Park in Iceland encompasses massive glaciers, active geothermal areas, and dramatic landscapes. It offers a glimpse into the forces of nature that shape Iceland's geology.
description_nl: Het Vatnajökull National Park in IJsland omvat massieve gletsjers, actieve geothermische gebieden en dramatische landschappen. Het biedt een blik op de natuurkrachten die de geologie van IJsland vormen.

name: Plitvice Lakes National Park
description_en: Plitvice Lakes National Park is renowned for its cascading lakes and waterfalls, interconnected by wooden walkways and lush forests. It is one of Croatia's most popular tourist destinations.
description_nl: Het Plitvice Meren Nationaal Park staat bekend om zijn watervallen en meren, verbonden door houten wandelpaden en weelderige bossen. Het is een van de meest populaire toeristische bestemmingen in Kroatië.

name: Durmitor National Park
description_en: Durmitor National Park features rugged mountains, glacial lakes, and the Tara River Canyon, one of the deepest gorges in Europe. It is a haven for hikers and outdoor enthusiasts.
description_nl: Het Durmitor Nationaal Park kenmerkt zich door ruige bergen, gletsjermeren en de Tara River Canyon, een van de diepste kloven van Europa. Het is een toevluchtsoord voor wandelaars en natuurliefhebbers.

name: Pirin National Park
description_en: Pirin National Park in Bulgaria features dramatic mountain peaks, glacial lakes, and diverse flora and fauna. The park is home to the rare edelweiss flower and offers numerous hiking opportunities.
description_nl: Het Pirin Nationaal Park in Bulgarije biedt dramatische bergtoppen, gletsjermeren en een diverse flora en fauna. Het park is de thuisbasis van de zeldzame edelweissbloem en biedt tal van wandelmogelijkheden.

name: Sarek National Park
description_en: Sarek National Park in Sweden is one of Europe's oldest national parks, known for its wild and untamed landscapes. It is a paradise for backpackers seeking solitude and adventure.
description_nl: Het Sarek Nationaal Park in Zweden is een van de oudste nationale parken in Europa, bekend om zijn wilde en ongerepte landschappen. Het is een paradijs voor backpackers die op zoek zijn naar eenzaamheid en avontuur.

name: Teide National Park
description_en: Teide National Park is centered around Mount Teide, the third highest volcanic structure in the world. The park showcases stunning volcanic landscapes and is recognized for its exceptional natural beauty.
description_nl: Het Teide Nationaal Park is geconcentreerd rond de vulkaan El Teide, de derde hoogste vulkanische structuur ter wereld. Het park toont adembenemende vulkanische landschappen en wordt erkend vanwege zijn buitengewone natuurlijke schoonheid.
